verdict.rationale: RustDesk's own docs say Server Pro includes audit logs, and the pricing page lists 'Audit log' as a feature, so a first-party audit capability exists. The evidence never describes what the log records or whether it can be exported, and it applies only to the paid Server Pro tier, not the OSS server. Missing for 10: documentation that logs capture who connected to which device and when, export (CSV/API) of audit records, retention details, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an IT admin, I can see a log of who connected to which machine and when, exportable for audit

citations.quote: Server Pro adds a web console, device groups, a shared address book, per-user and device-group access control, audit logs, and a management API.
